subject: Suggestions for Displaying large GeoTiff on google basemap with overlayed polygons

messages.author: c5b14246536698af
messages.subject: Suggestions for Displaying large GeoTiff on google basemap with overlayed polygons
parts:
all,

I'm looking for a suggested workflow/package approach for being able to display large scale satellite imagery on top of a basemap in a shiny app, with the ability to display polygons on top.  My difficulty is coming up with the best way to display raster files on top of a basemap layer.  I know that ggmap has the option to set maptype as satellite, but I want to put strips of my own imagery down on top of the traditional terrain view.  Any ideas on a basic approach would be greatly appreciated.


jordan
